basic_details.job_title: IAV Laboratory Instructor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: A temporary Laboratory Instructor post paying Rs. 55,000/- per month (consolidated) for an initial one year is open at the Institute of Advanced Virology (IAV), an institution under the Science & Technology Department of Government of Kerala. The essential qualification is a PhD in any branch of Life Sciences with five years of documented research/teaching experience in molecular biology/Virology. Applications are online only, until 10 December 2026, 05.00 PM (Advertisement No. IAV/342/HR/2026/01).

how_to_apply: Submit the online application using the link given in the notice: https://forms.gle/T3M8ZmNZP41CwiXv5, by 10 December 2026, 05.00 PM.
Give a valid e-mail ID, because all correspondence on this appointment will be through e-mail only.

Attach or submit the CGPA/Grade to % conversion formula (issued by the competent authority for the degree-awarding institution) if grading other than % is used and the formula is not already in the certificate/mark sheet.
Pay the application fee through SBI Collect: login to https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm.
In SBI Collect, select Educational Institutions, then Institute of Advanced Virology, then Fees Recruitment.
Make the payment of Rs.236/-. The notice states the fee as Rs. 200 + GST.
important_instructions: Amendments to the notification (if any) and the results will be published on the website of the institute. Applicants should check the website regularly for updates. Canvassing in any form is not permitted, and any interim enquiry will not be entertained. The Director, IAV reserves the right to decide the number of positions to be filled, and any matter related to the selection procedure, including cancellation of the selection process if circumstances demand.

content_sections.heading: IAV Laboratory Instructor at a Glance

rows.details: Initially for a period of one year

content_sections.heading: About IAV
content_sections.text: The Institute of Advanced Virology (IAV) is an institution under the Science & Technology Department of Government of Kerala. The notice describes it as having a focus on cutting-edge research initiatives in virology. This notice covers one temporary position.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age: 50 years as on 19.11.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. All educational qualification certificates must be from a recognized Board/University/Institute. Experience is counted from the date of acquiring the prescribed minimum essential educational qualification. Only candidates fulfilling all the essential qualifications and qualifying the screening by a duly constituted screening committee will be short-listed for the further selection process.

rows.minimum_essential_qualification: PhD in any branch of Life Sciences, and five years of documented research/teaching experience in the field of molecular biology/Virology.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 55,000/- per month (consolidated). The initial appointment is for one year. Subsequent extensions will be based on performance and approval from the competent authority of the Institute. The position is purely temporary. Selection does not entitle the candidate to any claim for future positions at IAV (permanent or otherwise). Selected candidates must join within 15 days from the date of the appointment order.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IAV Laboratory Instructor
content_sections.text: Submit the online application using the link given in the notice: https://forms.gle/T3M8ZmNZP41CwiXv5 , by 10 December 2026, 05.00 PM. Give a valid e-mail ID, because all correspondence on this appointment will be through e-mail only. Attach or submit the CGPA/Grade to % conversion formula (issued by the competent authority for the degree-awarding institution) if grading other than % is used and the formula is not already in the certificate/mark sheet. Pay the application fee through SBI Collect: login to https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm . In SBI Collect, select Educational Institutions, then Institute of Advanced Virology, then Fees Recruitment. Make the payment of Rs.236/-. The notice states the fee as Rs. 200 + GST.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A duly constituted screening committee screens the applications first. Only candidates who meet all essential qualifications and pass the screening are short-listed. Short-listed candidates will be selected through a selection process comprising a written test and/or interview. The notice does not print dates, venue or syllabus for these stages.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Amendments to the notification (if any) and the results will be published on the website of the institute. Applicants should check the website regularly for updates. Canvassing in any form is not permitted, and any interim enquiry will not be entertained. The Director, IAV reserves the right to decide the number of positions to be filled, and any matter related to the selection procedure, including cancellation of the selection process if circumstances demand.
